providers.service_territory: Southern Idaho and eastern Oregon; ~24,000 sq-mile area generally following the Snake River and its tributaries
providers.notes: Largest IOU in Idaho; regulated by IPUC. Subsidiary of IDACORP, Inc. Offers multiple C&I programs: Easy Upgrades, Custom Projects, New Buildings, Multifamily, Small Business Direct Install.

providers.service_territory: Northern Idaho (Coeur d'Alene, Sandpoint, Moscow, Lewiston areas) and eastern Washington
providers.notes: Second-largest IOU serving Idaho. Headquartered in Spokane, WA. Offers commercial programs: Custom Projects/Pay for Performance, Prescriptive, Foodservice, HVAC, Refrigeration, Green Motor Rewind, Compressed Air.

providers.service_territory: Eastern Idaho (Rexburg, Idaho Falls area, Bear Lake County) — PacifiCorp subsidiary
providers.notes: PacifiCorp subsidiary serving eastern Idaho. Wattsmart Business program updated November 17, 2025 with changes to lighting and green motor rewind. Offers Small/Medium Business Express, Large Business Custom, and Agricultural tracks.

providers.service_territory: City of Idaho Falls and surrounding areas (municipal utility)
providers.notes: Municipal utility owned by the City of Idaho Falls. Offers commercial lighting, HVAC, and custom project rebates plus zero-interest loan options. Pre-inspection required before purchase/installation.

providers.service_territory: Kootenai, Benewah, Bonner, and Spokane counties in northern Idaho — largest electric cooperative in Idaho
providers.notes: Largest electric co-op in Idaho. Member-owned cooperative. Has offered commercial energy efficiency programs historically; specific 2025 commercial program details require direct contact.

programs.program_name: Easy Upgrades — Commercial & Industrial Prescriptive Incentives (2025)
programs.stacking_rules: Cannot combine with Custom Projects for same measure
programs.program_notes_ai: Prescriptive program covering lighting, HVAC, motors, VFDs, compressed air, and other common commercial measures. Governed by the Commercial and Industrial Energy Efficiency Policies and Procedures Manual. DLC listing required for LED lighting measures. Applies to all business customers per the CIP manual.

programs.stacking_rules: Cannot stack with Easy Upgrades for same measure; 70% of eligible project cost cap applies
programs.program_notes_ai: Capital projects incentivized at $0.20/kWh saved (first year) or 70% of eligible project cost, whichever is less. Energy management projects incentivized at $0.025/kWh up to 100% of eligible project cost. Pre-approval required before project completion. Customers include dairies, manufacturers, food processors, water/wastewater systems, and schools.

Targets new construction and major renovation projects. Preliminary application required before project completion. Covers measures in lighting, HVAC, envelope, and other efficiency improvements that exceed code baseline.

Eligible for buildings with 5 or more attached individual dwelling units. Covers new construction, major renovation, and retrofit for dwelling units and common areas. Whole-building approach available with modeled energy savings incentive. Professional Assistance incentive available to design professional. Contact: Sheree Willhite, 208-388-6717, swillhite@idahopower.com.

required_documents: Proof of eligibility as small business customer
programs.program_notes_ai: Lighting incentives for a select group of small business customers. Details per Idaho Power's CIP Policies and Procedures Manual.

programs.program_name: Commercial Energy Efficiency Prescriptive Incentives — Idaho (2025)
programs.program_notes_ai: Covers HVAC, water heating, lighting, and other equipment upgrades. Must be an Avista commercial electric customer. Application must be submitted within 90–120 days of project completion. Contact your Avista account executive for program details.

programs.delivery_mechanism: Instant Discount at Point of Sale
programs.stacking_rules: Instant discount program — no paperwork required
programs.program_notes_ai: Instant rebate on qualifying commercial foodservice equipment with no paperwork for customers. Discount applied directly to purchase invoice by participating vendor.
Designed for grocery stores, supermarkets, convenience stores, and customers with commercial refrigeration equipment. Contact Avista account executive for details.

programs.stacking_rules: No paperwork required; discount applied by participating Green Rewind service center
programs.program_notes_ai: Customer takes eligible motor to a participating Green Rewind service center. Service center performs the rewind and applies an instant discount of $1 per horsepower on the invoice. No customer paperwork required. Must be an Avista commercial electric customer.

programs.program_name: Pay for Performance / Custom Projects — Idaho (2025)
programs.program_notes_ai: Incentive based on actual energy savings at the meter. Energy savings can come from building retrofits and equipment upgrades. Contact Avista account executive for details on eligibility and project scoping.

programs.program_name: Wattsmart Business — Small & Medium Business Express Incentives Idaho (2025)
programs.stacking_rules: Express program for verified small/medium business customers only; large customer incentives available through separate track
programs.rebate_payment_method: Check to vendor (customer co-pay as little as 25%)
programs.program_notes_ai: Updated November 17, 2025 with adjustments to lighting and green motor rewind offerings. Customer must verify size category at verify.wattsmartbusiness.com or by calling 1-866-870-3419. Trade ally manages installation and paperwork. Rocky Mountain Power pays remaining balance (up to 75%) directly to the vendor. Covers LED lighting upgrades primarily.

programs.program_name: Wattsmart Business — Large Business Custom Incentives Idaho (2025)
programs.program_notes_ai: Technical assistance and cash incentives for large commercial and industrial customers. Covers lighting, HVAC, motors, compressed air, and other measures. Updated November 17, 2025. Rocky Mountain Power partners with National Energy Improvement Fund (NEIF) to help businesses finance energy upgrades.

programs.program_name: Wattsmart Business — Prescriptive Lighting Express Idaho (2025)
programs.stacking_rules: Express lighting covers up to 70% of cost for qualifying LED fixtures
programs.program_notes_ai: Lighting Express allows smaller or routine LED lighting projects with minimal paperwork and shorter processing time. Customer purchases qualified fixtures or retrofit kits from vendor of choice, installs, then submits post-purchase application with W-9. Rebate check issued within 45 days. Covers up to 70% of installation cost.

Designed to help farms and dairies improve efficiency and grow their bottom line. Covers motors, irrigation, lighting, and other agricultural equipment. Contact RMP at 1-866-870-3419 for current measure list.

programs.stacking_rules: Customer may choose either rebate or loan, not both
programs.rebate_payment_method: Check (3–6 weeks) or Zero-Interest Loan to contractor
programs.program_notes_ai: Building must receive electricity service from Idaho Falls Power. A building audit must be conducted by IFP prior to purchase and installation. Rebates available up to 50% of qualifying installation cost. Zero-interest loan available up to 100% of actual cost, not to exceed $25,000. Rebate check takes 3–6 weeks. Contact ifpinfo@ifpower.org with subject 'ATTN: Commercial Lighting Calculator' for qualification estimate. Final inspection required before rebate is issued.

programs.stacking_rules: Customer may choose either rebate or loan, not both
programs.rebate_payment_method: Check (3–6 weeks) or Zero-Interest Loan to contractor
programs.program_notes_ai: Covers air source heat pumps, ductless heat pumps, HVAC control improvements/VFD, thermostats, and insulation. IFP must conduct an energy audit prior to purchase/installation. Rebates issued after final utility inspection. Up to 50% rebate or 100% zero-interest loan (max $25,000). Call 208-612-8430 for details.
Commercial and Industrial customers may create custom energy efficiency projects with Idaho Falls Power. Contact IFP at 208-612-8430 for eligibility and project scoping.

rate_schedules.description: Small commercial customers without demand metering; no peak demand charge
rate_schedules.notes: Applies to small commercial accounts not requiring demand metering. Includes 4% Energy Efficiency Rider in base rate.

rate_schedules.description: Secondary voltage service with demand metering; summer demand $9.49/kW, winter demand $7.75/kW; Basic Charge $1.84/kW
rate_schedules.notes: Includes Basic Charge per kW of $1.84. Summer demand charge $9.49/kW; winter $7.75/kW. Summer energy 5.0908¢/kWh; winter 4.9875¢/kWh. Optional TOU rates available.

rate_schedules.description: Optional TOU rate for Schedule 9 customers; on-peak and off-peak energy and demand differentiation
rate_schedules.notes: Optional TOU service available for Schedule 9 customers. Specific on-peak/off-peak energy and demand rates require tariff sheet review at puc.idaho.gov.

rate_schedules.description: Large power service for customers with 1,000 kW or greater demand; secondary voltage; on-peak and off-peak billing demand structure; Basic Load Capacity based on two highest monthly demands in 12-month period
rate_schedules.notes: Minimum billing demand 1,000 kW. On-Peak Billing Demand based on 15-minute maximum during on-peak periods. Includes 4% Energy Efficiency Rider. Superseded prior Schedule 19. Effective 01/31/2025.

rate_schedules.schedule_name: Schedule 20 — Large Power Service (Transmission Voltage) — 1,000 kW+
rate_schedules.description: Transmission voltage service for customers with 1,000 kW or more demand; special contract option available for 10,000–20,000 kW firm demand customers
rate_schedules.notes: Special contract available for firm demand 10,000–20,000 kW with IPUC approval. Speculative High-Density Load rates apply if demand does not maintain 1,000 kW threshold consistently.

rate_schedules.description: Seasonal pumping service for irrigation and soil drainage; separately metered water pumping systems
rate_schedules.notes: Irrigation class customers have separately metered water pumping or delivery systems. Specific rates in tariff on file with IPUC.

rate_schedules.description: Street and area outdoor lighting service; energy charge determined by load size and number of units served
rate_schedules.notes: Billed based on daily kWh calculated on load size and unit count multiplied by actual days. Proration per Rule G of tariff.

rate_schedules.description: General commercial service at distribution voltage; demand-metered accounts under 1,000 kW
rate_schedules.notes: Idaho tariff filed with IPUC. Rate details in PacifiCorp Idaho tariff P.S.C. No. 52. Specific kWh and demand rates require tariff PDF review.

rate_schedules.schedule_name: Schedule 6A — General Service Energy Time-of-Day Option
rate_schedules.description: Optional time-of-day energy pricing for general service distribution voltage customers
rate_schedules.notes: Optional TOU energy pricing overlay on Schedule 6. Specific rates in PacifiCorp Idaho tariff.

rate_schedules.schedule_name: Schedule 8 — Large General Service (Distribution Voltage) — 1,000 kW+
rate_schedules.description: Large general service at distribution voltage for accounts with 1,000 kW or greater demand
rate_schedules.notes: Filed with IPUC for Idaho service territory. Specific kWh and demand rates in PacifiCorp Idaho tariff P.S.C. No. 52.

rate_schedules.description: High voltage service for large general service customers
rate_schedules.notes: No new service per IPUC tariff index. Specific rates in PacifiCorp Idaho tariff P.S.C. No. 52.

rate_schedules.schedule_name: Schedule 10 — Irrigation and Soil Drainage Pumping Power Service
rate_schedules.description: Seasonal pumping service for irrigation and soil drainage in Rocky Mountain Power's Idaho service territory
rate_schedules.notes: Specific rates in PacifiCorp Idaho tariff P.S.C. No. 52. Contact RMP for current seasonal rates.

rate_schedules.description: Security and area lighting service in Rocky Mountain Power's Idaho territory
rate_schedules.notes: Specific rates in PacifiCorp Idaho tariff P.S.C. No. 52.

rate_schedules.description: Standard commercial service; energy rate $0.045/kWh; demand charge $11.00/kW (peak); minimum demand charge $26.00/billing cycle
rate_schedules.notes: Power cost adjustment currently ($0.003)/kWh (credit). Minimum demand charge of $26.00 imposed if calculated demand charge is less. Demand charge covers fixed infrastructure costs.

rate_schedules.description: Large industrial customers; energy rate $0.044/kWh; demand charge $8.75/kW (peak)
rate_schedules.notes: Power cost adjustment currently ($0.003)/kWh (credit). Lower per-kWh rate than standard commercial reflects higher load factor of industrial customers.

forms.program_name: Easy Upgrades — Commercial & Industrial Prescriptive Incentives (2025)
forms.form_notes: Application submitted post-installation for prescriptive measures. Details in CIP Policies and Procedures Manual at docs.idahopower.com/pdfs/energyefficiency/business/proceduresManual.pdf
Must be submitted before project completion. Idaho Power contacts customer after submission to walk through next steps. Incentive check issued after project verification.
Program overview brochure for the Custom Projects commercial and industrial energy efficiency program.
Must be completed before project completion and emailed in Excel format to multifamily@idahopower.com. Required before purchase/installation.

forms.program_name: Commercial & Industrial Energy Efficiency Policies and Procedures Manual
forms.form_notes: Governing reference document for all Idaho Power commercial and industrial energy efficiency programs including Easy Upgrades, Custom Projects, New Buildings, and Multifamily.

forms.program_name: Commercial Energy Efficiency Prescriptive Incentives — Idaho (2025)
forms.form_notes: Must be submitted within 90–120 days of project completion (per Idaho program rules). Must include contractor invoices and required documentation. For rebate payable to vendor, customer signs a release form per program policy.

forms.program_name: Commercial Energy Efficiency Prescriptive Incentives — Idaho (2025)
forms.form_name: Avista Incentive Payment Vendor Release Form
forms.form_notes: Required if customer elects to have incentive check made payable and sent to vendor/contractor rather than directly to customer.

forms.program_name: Wattsmart Business — Prescriptive Lighting Express Idaho (2025)
forms.form_notes: Submitted after installation. Must include IRS Form W-9. Rebate check issued within 45 days of complete submission.

forms.program_name: Wattsmart Business — Prescriptive Lighting Express Idaho (2025)
forms.form_notes: Required with all Rocky Mountain Power Idaho Wattsmart rebate applications.

forms.program_name: Wattsmart Business — Small & Medium Business Express Incentives Idaho (2025)
forms.form_notes: Customer must verify size category before participating in Small/Medium Business Express program. Can also verify by calling 1-866-870-3419. Trade ally handles remaining paperwork.

forms.form_name: Idaho Falls Power Commercial Lighting Application
forms.form_notes: Pre-inspection must be scheduled before application is submitted. Application required prior to purchase/installation. Email ifpinfo@ifpower.org with subject 'ATTN: Commercial Lighting Calculator' to begin process. Final inspection by IFP required before rebate issuance.

forms.form_name: Idaho Falls Power Commercial HVAC Application
forms.form_notes: Energy audit by IFP must be completed before purchase and installation. Application required. Final inspection required before rebate or loan disbursement. Call 208-612-8430 to schedule.
